title: From the Unknown to the Desired: Transforming Unknown Initial States in the Resource Theory of Work and Heat
abstract: We study thermodynamic state transformations in the resource theory of work and heat when the initial quantum state is unknown. Moving beyond state-dependent protocols, we develop a universal framework in which a single transformation applies to all admissible input states. For mutually commuting conserved charges, we construct charge-conserving protocols whose transformation error, quantified by trace distance, decays super-polynomially with the number of system copies. As an application, we demonstrate universal work extraction: asymptotically optimal work can be extracted without microscopic knowledge of the initial state, with a super-polynomially small error. Our results show that thermodynamic state transformations remain achievable under limited prior information and establish a universal framework for resource-theoretic thermodynamics beyond the state-aware setting.
summary: 当初始量子态未知时，我们研究功和热资源理论中的热力学状态转变。超越依赖于状态的协议，我们开发了一个通用框架，其中单个转换适用于所有可接受的输入状态。对于相互交换的守恒电荷，我们构建了电荷守恒协议，其转换误差（通过迹线距离量化）随系统副本的数量超多项式衰减。作为一个应用，我们演示了通用功提取：无需初始状态的微观知识即可提取渐近最优功，且误差超多项式小。我们的结果表明，热力学状态转换在有限的先验信息下仍然可以实现，并为超越状态感知设置的资源理论热力学建立了通用框架。

title: Non-Multiplicativity of the Holevo Barycenter of Quantum Channels
abstract: The Holevo barycenter of a quantum channel is the unique output state obtained as the average output of any ensemble achieving the Holevo capacity. Given two quantum channels, the multiplicativity problem asks whether this barycenter tensorizes under parallel composition, namely whether the barycenter of the product channel coincides with the tensor product of the individual barycenters. This question is closely related to the additivity problem for the Holevo capacity: additivity implies tensorization of the Holevo barycenter, while tensorization alone is not sufficient for additivity. Although a construction is known that demonstrates the existence of channels with non-additive Holevo capacity, their corresponding Holevo barycenters still tensorize, leaving open whether multiplicativity might ultimately hold universally. Here, we answer this question in the negative by exhibiting channels for which the Holevo barycenter is not multiplicative under the tensor product of the channel with itself. Moreover, we show that the entropy of the Holevo barycenter is neither universally subadditive nor universally superadditive under tensor product.
summary: 量子通道的 Holevo 重心是作为实现 Holevo 容量的任何系综的平均输出而获得的唯一输出状态。给定两个量子通道，乘性问题询问该质心是否在并行组合下张量化，即乘积通道的质心是否与各个质心的张量积一致。这个问题与 Holevo 容量的可加性问题密切相关：可加性意味着 Holevo 重心的张量化，而单独的张量化不足以实现可加性。尽管已知一种构造证明了具有非加性 Holevo 容量的通道的存在，但它们相应的 Holevo 重心仍然张量化，这使得乘法性是否最终普遍成立仍存在疑问。在这里，我们通过展示 Holevo 质心在通道与其自身的张量积下不相乘的通道来否定地回答这个问题。此外，我们证明了 Holevo 质心的熵在张量积下既不是普遍次可加性的，也不是普遍超可加性的。

title: Induced random mixed states are symmetric Dirichlet mixtures
abstract: We establish an exact equivalence in distribution between $D$-dimensional random mixed states induced by partial traces over $K$-dimensional environments and the Mai-Alquier distribution, a mixture of $K$ independent Haar-random pure states weighted by a symmetric Dirichlet distribution. This identification recasts a class of expectation values for induced ensembles into calculations involving Dirichlet moments and low-order Haar averages on a single-system state space. As applications, we recover exact purity moments up to fourth order, derive the mean Hilbert--Schmidt distance between independent induced ensembles with possibly different environment dimensions, and obtain exact average determinants. These results provide a unified and constructive perspective on induced random mixed states and on the evaluation of quantities such as purity moments, overlaps, and determinants.
summary: 我们在 $K$ 维环境上的部分迹线引起的 $D$ 维随机混合状态与 Mai-Alquier 分布之间建立了精确的等价分布，Mai-Alquier 分布是由对称 Dirichlet 分布加权的 $K$ 独立 Haar 随机纯状态的混合。这种识别将诱导系综的一类期望值重新转换为涉及单系统状态空间上的狄利克雷矩和低阶哈尔平均值的计算。作为应用，我们恢复了高达四阶的精确纯度矩，导出具有可能不同环境维度的独立诱导系综之间的平均希尔伯特-施密特距离，并获得精确的平均行列式。这些结果为诱导随机混合态以及纯度矩、重叠和行列式等量的评估提供了统一且建设性的视角。

title: Noise Limits on Fault-Tolerant Fermionic Quantum Computing
abstract: Determining the highest amount of noise that quantum circuits can handle is an interesting and crucial task in the development of fault-tolerant quantum computation. Previous work has constrained this upper limit for local depolarizing noise to $\approx 45~\%$ for circuits constructed using the universal Clifford with T gate set by finding the noise threshold where the gate set loses universality. In this work, we use a similar method with the matchgate with non-Gaussian resource universal gate set to find a limit of $p=(8 - 2 \sqrt{6})/5$ or $\approx 62~\%$ for fermionic quantum computing that is independent of circuit depth. To do this, we use Uhlmann-Wootters concurrences for a 4-mode fermionic Choi state representing a resourceful gate combined with local depolarizing noise to determine when the combined channel is convex Gaussian. These bounds are not directly comparable due to differences in noise model making the bound of $\approx 62~\%$ the best known for fermions.
summary: 确定量子电路可以处理的最高噪声量是容错量子计算发展中一项有趣且至关重要的任务。先前的工作通过找到门组失去通用性的噪声阈值，将使用具有 T 门组的通用 Clifford 构建的电路的局部去极化噪声上限限制为 $\approx 45~\%$。在这项工作中，我们使用类似的方法与具有非高斯资源通用门集的匹配门来找到与电路深度无关的费米子量子计算的极限 $p=(8 - 2 \sqrt{6})/5$ 或 $\approx 62~\%$。为此，我们使用代表资源门的 4 模费米子 Choi 态的 Uhlmann-Wootters 并发与局部去极化噪声相结合来确定组合通道何时为凸高斯分布。由于噪声模型的差异，这些界限不能直接比较，这使得 $\approx 62~\%$ 的界限成为费米子最著名的界限。

title: Sub-extensive non-stabilizerness in the Dyck-Fredkin spin chain
abstract: The stabilizer Rényi entropy is a quantitative measure of non-stabilizerness, or magic, and has typically been found to scale extensively with system size $N$ (i.e., $\Theta(N)$) for a variety of many-body quantum states. In this note, we study the stabilizer Rényi entropy of the ground state of the spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ Dyck-Fredkin chain and its $t$-deformation, a local frustration-free model with unusual spectral-gap scaling. Exploiting the combinatorial structure, we carry out numerically exact finite-size calculations, which indicate asymptotic behavior depending on $t$: $\Theta(N)$ for $t<1$, $\Theta(\log N)$ at $t=1$, and $\Theta(1)$ for $t>1$. The scaling at $t=1$ could be another manifestation of the unconventional criticality of the model, while the contrast with the behavior of the entanglement entropy suggests that non-stabilizerness might provide a new window into quantum many-body systems.
summary: 稳定器 Rényi 熵是非稳定器或魔力的定量测量，并且通常被发现对于各种多体量子态随系统大小 $N$（即 $\Theta(N)$）广泛扩展。在这篇文章中，我们研究了自旋 $\frac{1}{2}$ Dyck-Fredkin 链基态的稳定器 Rényi 熵及其 $t$ 变形，这是一种具有异常谱间隙缩放的局部无挫败模型。利用组合结构，我们进行数值精确的有限大小计算，这表明渐近行为取决于$t$：$\Theta(N)$ for $t<1$，$\Theta(\log N)$ at $t=1$，$\Theta(1)$ for $t>1$。 $t=1$ 处的缩放可能是模型非常规临界性的另一种表现，而与纠缠熵行为的对比表明非稳定器可能为量子多体系统提供一个新的窗口。

title: ECDSA.Fail: Open Autoresearch for Optimizing Elliptic-Curve Point Addition in Shor's Algorithm
abstract: We propose Open Autoresearch, a paradigm in which humans and AI agents publish evaluator-verified improvements to a public leaderboard. We instantiate it in this http URL , optimizing reversible secp256k1 point-addition circuits, a bottleneck in Shor's algorithm for elliptic-curve cryptography. The benchmark minimizes the spacetime-inspired score $S=Q\times T$, where $Q$ is peak logical qubit width and $T$ is average executed Toffoli count. Participants reduced $S$ by 86.1%. At the data cutoff (26 July 2026), the best-scoring circuit uses 1,151 qubits and 1,299,453 average executed Toffoli gates, giving $Q\times T\approx1.496$ billion. This is more than 50% below Google's published point-addition score thresholds ( arXiv:2603.28846 ), under different accounting conventions. Because the benchmark supplies one addend classically, we construct a coherent windowed-addition-compatible variant implementing the single-call interface required by windowed Shor. It uses 1,162 qubits and 1,684,161 average executed Toffoli gates. On 100,000 random inputs, its empirical success probability is $\hat{p}=0.99809$, giving $Q\times T/\hat{p}\approx1.961$ billion under an independently rerunnable per-call sensitivity model, not a full-Shor success estimate. Its qubit and Toffoli counts lie below Google's published thresholds and Schrottenloher's reported operating points ( arXiv:2606.02235 ), although differing interfaces, accounting conventions, and validation scope preclude formal dominance. After the cutoff, the score was further reduced to 1.259 billion, while a separate low-width circuit reached 813 qubits. The public record shows AI agents complementing human judgment, providing evidence for open autoresearch on efficiently evaluable, machine-checkable objectives.
summary:
我们提出开放自动研究，这是一种人类和人工智能代理向公共排行榜发布经过评估者验证的改进的范例。我们在此 http URL 中实例化它，优化可逆 secp256k1 点加法电路，这是 Shor 椭圆曲线加密算法的瓶颈。该基准测试最小化了时空得分 $S=Q\times T$，其中 $Q$ 是峰值逻辑量子位宽度，$T$ 是平均执行的 Toffoli 计数。参与者减少了 86.1% 新元。在数据截止时（2026 年 7 月 26 日），得分最高的电路使用 1,151 个量子位和 1,299,453 个平均执行的 Toffoli 门，带来 Q\times T\approx14.96 亿美元。根据不同的会计惯例，这比 Google 公布的加分分数阈值 (arXiv:2603.28846) 低 50% 以上。由于基准测试通常提供一个加数，因此我们构建了一种一致的窗口加法兼容变体，实现窗口 Shor 所需的单调用接口。它使用 1,162 个量子位和 1,684,161 个平均执行的 Toffoli 门。

对于 100,000 个随机输入，其经验成功概率为 $\hat{p}=0.99809$，在独立可重新运行的每次调用灵敏度模型下给出 $Q\times T/\hat{p}\approx1.961$ 十亿美元，而不是完整的 Shor 成功估计。其量子比特和 Toffoli 计数低于 Google 公布的阈值和 Schrottenloher 报告的操作点 (arXiv:2606.02235)，尽管不同的接口、会计惯例和验证范围排除了正式的主导地位。截止后，分数进一步降低至12.59亿，而单独的低宽度电路达到了813个量子位。公共记录显示人工智能代理补充了人类的判断，为有效评估、机器可检查的目标的开放自动研究提供了证据。

title: Information-geometric bounds on nonequilibrium relaxation in quantum Markov dynamics
abstract: In this paper, we study the quantum information-geometric structure underlying short-time nonequilibrium relaxation in quantum Markov dynamics, and derive bounds on the nonequilibrium correction to the short-time relaxation curvature. These bounds generalize the information-geometric structure underlying Auconi's classical nonequilibrium relaxation inequality to quantum Markov dynamics. We consider the von Neumann relative entropy as quantum divergence, and parametrize perturbations through the Kubo-Mori map, which converts the second-order expansion of the relative entropy into the Bogoliubov-Kubo-Mori (BKM) inner product at all temperatures. For a quantum Markov semigroup with full-rank stationary state, the induced tangent-space generator admits a canonical decomposition into a BKM-symmetric and a BKM-antisymmetric part, and the leading nonequilibrium curvature correction takes the exact form of the expectation of the commutator between the dissipative and the transport part of the generator. This correction is bounded by the product of a BKM-symmetric dissipative activity and a transport-sector activity. The bound is verified on a noncommuting qubit model and a driven-dissipative qutrit, and the full chain is confirmed numerically on a two-dimensional Fokker-Planck steady state. In the high-temperature and overdamped limit the quantum formula reduces to the position-space Fokker-Planck expression and reproduces Auconi's entropy-production bound with the correct temperature factor.
summary:
在本文中，我们研究了量子马尔可夫动力学中短时非平衡弛豫背后的量子信息几何结构，并推导了短时弛豫曲率的非平衡校正的界限。这些界限将奥科尼经典非平衡松弛不等式背后的信息几何结构推广到量子马尔可夫动力学。我们将冯·诺依曼相对熵视为量子散度，并通过 Kubo-Mori 图对扰动进行参数化，将相对熵的二阶展开转换为所有温度下的 Bogoliubov-Kubo-Mori (BKM) 内积。对于具有满秩稳态的量子马尔可夫半群，诱导切线空间生成器允许规范分解为 BKM 对称和 BKM 反对称部分，并且领先的非平衡曲率校正采用生成器耗散部分和输运部分之间换向器期望的精确形式。该修正受到 BKM 对称耗散活动和传输扇区活动的乘积的限制。

该界限在非对易量子位模型和驱动耗散量子体上进行了验证，并且在二维福克-普朗克稳态上对整个链进行了数值确认。在高温和过阻尼极限下，量子公式简化为位置空间福克-普朗克表达式，并用正确的温度因子重现奥科尼的熵产生界。

title: Convex-Gaussianity of fermionic Gibbs states in perturbation theory
abstract: We study the structure of Gibbs states in weakly perturbed interacting fermionic systems. First, for a sparse Hamiltonian $H=H_0+V$ with a quadratic term $H_0$ and a non-quadratic perturbation $V$ of scale $\epsilon$, we show that the Gibbs state $\rho_{\beta}$ decomposes into a convex combination of Gaussian states whenever the inverse temperature satisfies $\beta \le O(\log(1/\epsilon))$. Moreover, we prove that this bound is asymptotically tight by establishing that $\beta \le \Theta(\log(1/\epsilon))$ is necessary for certain sparse Hamiltonians. This general framework applies directly to the weak-coupling (small-$\vert{}U\vert{}$) regime of the Fermi--Hubbard model with hopping $t$ and on-site interaction $U$ on any graph of maximum degree $D$. Complementarily, in the strong-coupling (small-$\vert{}t\vert{}$) regime, we show that the Gibbs state remains convex-Gaussian up to $\beta \le O\big(\vert{}U\vert{}^{-1}\log(\vert{}U\vert{}/(D\vert{}t\vert{}))\big)$, revealing a mechanism for convex-Gaussianity distinct from the weak-coupling setting.
summary: 我们研究弱扰动相互作用费米子系统中吉布斯态的结构。首先，对于具有二次项 $H_0$ 和尺度为 $\epsilon$ 的非二次扰动 $V$ 的稀疏哈密顿量 $H=H_0+V$，我们表明只要逆温度满足 $\beta \le O(\log(1/\epsilon))$，吉布斯状态 $\rho_{\beta}$ 就会分解为高斯状态的凸组合。此外，我们通过建立 $\beta \le \Theta(\log(1/\epsilon))$ 对于某些稀疏哈密顿量是必要的来证明这个界限是渐近紧的。这个通用框架直接适用于费米-哈伯德模型的弱耦合（小$\vert{}U\vert{}$）体系，在任何最大度$D$的图上具有跳跃$t$和现场相互作用$U$。作为补充，在强耦合 (small-$\vert{}t\vert{}$) 体系中，我们表明吉布斯状态在 $\beta \le O\big(\vert{}U\vert{}^{-1}\log(\vert{}U\vert{}/(D\vert{}t\vert{}))\big)$ 范围内仍保持凸高斯状态，揭示了一种与弱耦合设置。

title: A Sum-of-Squares Hierarchy with Quadratic Convergence for Quantum Channel Coding
abstract: Computing the optimal success probability for transmitting classical messages through a single use of a quantum channel is NP-hard, even for two messages. An existing semidefinite programming hierarchy based on symmetric extensions provides convergent upper bounds with an a priori error estimate that decays as the inverse square root of the extension level. In this work, we construct a Hermitian sum-of-squares hierarchy for an arbitrary number of messages and prove quadratic convergence in its level. The error bound is proportional to the advantage over random guessing. Our approach combines state-discrimination duality with positive polynomial kernels on products of spheres to construct feasible polynomial dual certificates. For binary messages, the resulting bounds give a multiplicative approximation from above of the trace-norm contraction coefficient.
summary: 计算通过单次使用量子通道传输经典消息的最佳成功概率是 NP 困难的，即使对于两条消息也是如此。基于对称扩展的现有半定编程层次结构提供了收敛上限以及先验误差估计，该估计随着扩展级别的倒数平方根而衰减。在这项工作中，我们为任意数量的消息构建了厄米平方和层次结构，并证明了其层次上的二次收敛性。误差范围与相对于随机猜测的优势成正比。我们的方法将状态歧视对偶性与球体乘积上的正多项式核相结合，以构造可行的多项式对偶证书。对于二进制消息，所得界限给出了迹范数收缩系数上方的乘法近似。

title: Perfect State Transfer from a Localised Two-Excitation State to a Dicke State via Static Spin-Network Hamiltonians
abstract: I construct a family of time-independent, excitation-preserving spin Hamiltonians that realises perfect state transfer from a localised two-excitation state to the symmetric two-excitation Dicke state, for every system size $N \ge 4$. The Hamiltonian has the physical form $H = \sum_{i<j} J_{ij} (\sigma_i^+ \sigma_j^- + \sigma_j^+ \sigma_i^-) + \sum_i \epsilon_i n_i$ with real couplings, and satisfies $e^{-iHt} |110\cdots0\rangle = e^{i\phi} |D_N^{(2)}\rangle$ at a finite time. The construction exploits an $S_{N-2}$ permutation symmetry acting on the initially unoccupied spins, which reduces the dynamics to a four-dimensional invariant subspace. Requiring $(|\psi_0\rangle + |D_N^{(2)}\rangle)/2$ to be a zero eigenvector determines the on-site energies in closed form and leaves three coupling parameters free. The remaining inverse spectral problem reduces to two polynomial equations in two dimensionless coupling ratios; eliminating one ratio yields a degree-six reciprocal polynomial, which the substitution $z = x + x^{-1}$ converts to a cubic. For the spectral family $(-n,-1,1)$, with $n$ an odd integer, an explicit factorisation of the leading coefficient together with a boundary evaluation at $z=-2$ shows that for every $N \ge 4$ an odd $n$ can be chosen large enough that a real root with $z < -2$ exists; a subresultant argument supplies a real lift of that root to the original system. The existence proof is entirely symbolic and does not rely on numerical optimisation; direct propagation is used only as independent validation. The result is a constrained analogue of perfect state transfer: unlike the general real-state problem, where an unconstrained real symmetric matrix suffices, here the Hamiltonian is required to arise from an excitation-preserving spin-network form.
summary:
我构建了一系列与时间无关、保持激发的自旋哈密顿量，对于每个系统大小 $N \ge 4$ 来说，它实现了从局域双激发态到对称双激发迪克态的完美状态转移。哈密顿量的物理形式为 $H = \sum_{i<j} J_{ij} (\sigma_i^+ \sigma_j^- + \sigma_j^+ \sigma_i^-) + \sum_i \epsilon_i n_i$ 且具有实数耦合，并满足 $e^{-iHt} |110\cdots0\rangle = e^{i\phi} |D_N^{(2)}\rangle$ 在有限时间内。该构造利用了作用于最初未占据的自旋的 $S_{N-2}$ 排列对称性，从而将动力学简化为四维不变子空间。要求 $(|\psi_0\rangle + |D_N^{(2)}\rangle)/2$ 为零特征向量，确定封闭形式的现场能量，并保留三个耦合参数。剩下的反谱问题简化为两个无量纲耦合比的多项式方程；消除一个比率会产生六次倒数多项式，替换 $z = x + x^{-1}$ 将其转换为三次多项式。

对于谱族 $(-n,-1,1)$，其中 $n$ 为奇数整数，对前导系数的显式分解以及 $z=-2$ 处的边界评估表明，对于每个 $N \ge 4$ ，可以选择足够大的奇数 $n$ ，以便存在 $z < -2$ 的实数根；子结果论证将该根真正提升到原始系统。存在性证明完全是象征性的，不依赖于数值优化；直接传播仅用作独立验证。结果是完美状态转移的受约束模拟：与一般的实状态问题不同，在一般的实状态问题中，无约束的实对称矩阵就足够了，这里哈密顿量需要从激励保持自旋网络形式中产生。

title: Small-Bias Quantum Approximate Counting via the Multiplicative Adversary Method
abstract: We study the two-weight decision version of quantum approximate counting: given oracle access to $x\in\{0,1\}^N$, distinguish $|x|=M$ from $|x|=M+\Delta$ with success probability $1/2+\zeta$. Using the multiplicative adversary method, we prove $\Omega\left(\max\left\{\zeta\sqrt{(N-M)(M+\Delta)}/\Delta,\sqrt{\zeta N/\Delta}\right\}\right)$. The same parameter dependence follows from the polynomial-method characterization of the two-layer symmetric function by Podder, Yao, and Ye. Our contribution is a multiplicative-adversary derivation that tracks the progress produced by individual oracle queries. For the first term, after complementing the input if necessary, we assume $M+\Delta\le N-M$. We use the Hamming-layer subspaces from the eigenspace method of Ambainis, Spalek, and de Wolf and compose their adjacent-layer unitary maps to relate the two nonadjacent promise layers. After fixing the queried coordinate, the analysis block-diagonalizes into four-dimensional subspaces. An exact calculation of the one-query progress ratio gives the first lower bound. The same estimate also implies $\left\|(I-\widehat{\Pi}_{\mathrm{bad}})\lvert\Psi^T\rangle\right\|^2=O\left(T^2\Delta^2/((N-M)(M+\Delta))\right)$ for the coherent input superposition used in the adversary argument. For the second term, we prove directly using a three-eigenvalue multiplicative adversary that unique OR on $n$ bits with success probability $1/2+\zeta$ requires $\Omega(\sqrt{\zeta n})$ queries, and then reduce unique OR to the two-weight counting problem.
summary:
我们研究量子近似计数的二重决策版本：给定预言机访问 $x\in\{0,1\}^N$ 的权限，区分 $|x|=M$ 和 $|x|=M+\Delta$ ，成功概率为 $1/2+\zeta$。使用乘法对抗方法，我们证明$\Omega\left(\max\left\{\zeta\sqrt{(N-M)(M+\Delta)}/\Delta,\sqrt{\zeta N/\Delta}\right\}\right)$。 Podder、Yao 和 Ye 对两层对称函数的多项式方法表征也得出相同的参数依赖性。我们的贡献是乘法对手推导，跟踪各个预言机查询产生的进度。对于第一项，在必要时对输入进行补充后，我们假设 $M+\Delta\le N-M$。我们使用 Ambainis、Spalek 和 de Wolf 的特征空间方法中的 Hamming 层子空间，并组合它们的相邻层酉映射来关联两个不相邻的 Promise 层。固定查询的坐标后，分析块对角化为四维子空间。单查询进度率的精确计算给出了第一个下限。

同样的估计还意味着 $\left\|(I-\widehat{\Pi}_{\mathrm{bad}})\lvert\Psi^T\rangle\right\|^2=O\left(T^2\Delta^2/((N-M)(M+\Delta))\right)$ 用于对手论证中使用的相干输入叠加。对于第二项，我们直接使用三特征值乘法对手证明，成功概率为 $1/2+\zeta$ 的 $n$ 位上的唯一 OR 需要 $\Omega(\sqrt{\zeta n})$ 查询，然后将唯一 OR 简化为双权重计数问题。

title: Dynamic Observable Subspaces: Fast Simulation of Observable Quantum Dynamics
abstract: By decomposing quantum dynamics across the Lie orbits of a list of observables, we find polynomial bounded classical simulations for the dynamics of the quantum system given a polynomial sized dynamic Lie algebra (DLA) for the generators of the quantum system. To do so, we describe how to construct the Dynamic Observable Subspace (DOS) that captures all the relevant dynamics for calculating expectation values for a specific observable for Pauli strings, diffusor mixers, and general local generators. Efficient sparse matrix representation, decoupling nonlinearity from such representation and basis construction with permissible pruning allows us to simulate the closed dynamics of such systems with hundreds of qubits. Moreover, we find that while restricted DOS circuits may not express the space of an associated Hamiltonian, they can dramatically outperform a fully expressive circuit due to the absence of the Barren Plateau. While classically simulatable, such circuits can still exhibit a form of quantum advantage through inference, act as warm starting for more expressive circuits, and find high quality trial states for Quantum Amplitude Amplification or Quantum Phase Estimation. In the simulation of quantum dynamics, we find that our restricted circuit can be simulated in polynomial time while producing high quality guiding state for downstream tasks like Quantum Phase Estimation with significantly lower energy than circuits with full expressivity.
summary:
通过分解一系列可观测量的李轨道上的量子动力学，给定量子系统生成器的多项式大小的动态李代数（DLA），我们找到了量子系统动力学的多项式有界经典模拟。为此，我们描述了如何构建动态可观测子空间（DOS），该子空间捕获所有相关动态，以计算泡利弦、扩散器混合器和一般本地生成器的特定可观测值的期望值。高效的稀疏矩阵表示、通过允许的修剪将非线性从这种表示和基础构造中解耦，使我们能够用数百个量子位来模拟此类系统的封闭动态。此外，我们发现虽然受限 DOS 电路可能无法表达相关哈密顿量的空间，但由于不存在 Barren Plateau，它们的性能可以显着优于完全表达的电路。虽然经典可模拟，但此类电路仍然可以通过推理表现出某种形式的量子优势，充当更具表现力的电路的热启动，并为量子振幅放大或量子相位估计找到高质量的试验状态。

在量子动力学的模拟中，我们发现我们的受限电路可以在多项式时间内进行模拟，同时为量子相位估计等下游任务产生高质量的引导状态，其能量明显低于具有完全表达能力的电路。

title: Minimax games for quantum channel discrimination
abstract: Quantum channel discrimination is a primitive task for identifying, verifying, and benchmarking quantum dynamics. Previous studies have primarily considered either the best-case tester-input setting or the worst-case jammer-input setting. Here, we introduce a game-theoretic framework in which both the tester and jammer control separate inputs. Combining three input structures, characterized by whether the tester and jammer use entangled inputs or IID inputs across channel uses, with four information patterns, determined by the visibility of the jammer's strategy and its knowledge of the true hypothesis, yields twelve game models. We provide exact finite blocklength hypothesis testing characterizations of all twelve models in terms of nine minimax hypothesis testing divergences and derive their asymptotic Stein exponents. Notably, for entangled jammers, neither the visibility of the jammer's strategy nor its knowledge of the true hypothesis affects the asymptotic Stein exponent, whereas the information pattern remains consequential for IID jammers. As an example, we study the discrimination of a general channel from a replacer channel and show that all asymptotic Stein exponents coincide with the same additive, single letter quantity. We further develop a general argument that upgrades achievability results to strong converse results, thereby establishing strong converse properties for several game models, resolving an open problem in composite hypothesis testing posed by Berta et al. [Commun. Math. Phys. 385, 55 (2021)], and strengthening several recent results of Lami [ arXiv:2510.06340 ]. The framework and techniques developed here may support future studies of quantum information tasks involving competing roles.
summary:
量子通道辨别是识别、验证和基准化量子动力学的一项原始任务。以前的研究主要考虑了最佳情况的测试仪输入设置或最坏情况的干扰器输入设置。在这里，我们介绍一个博弈论框架，其中测试仪和干扰器控制单独的输入。将三种输入结构（以测试器和干扰器是否使用跨通道使用纠缠输入或 IID 输入为特征）与四种信息模式（由干扰器策略的可见性及其对真实假设的了解确定）相结合，产生十二种博弈模型。我们根据九个极小极大假设检验散度提供了所有十二个模型的精确有限块长度假设检验特征，并推导了它们的渐近 Stein 指数。值得注意的是，对于纠缠干扰机，干扰机策略的可见性及其对真实假设的了解都不会影响渐近斯坦指数，而信息模式对于 IID 干扰机仍然很重要。

作为一个例子，我们研究了一般通道与替代通道的区别，并表明所有渐近 Stein 指数都与相同的加性单字母数量一致。我们进一步发展了一个一般论点，将可实现性结果升级为强逆结果，从而为多个博弈模型建立强逆属性，解决了 Berta 等人提出的复合假设检验中的开放问题。 [通讯。数学。物理。 385, 55 (2021)]，并加强了 Lami 最近的几项成果 [arXiv:2510.06340]。这里开发的框架和技术可能支持未来涉及竞争角色的量子信息任务的研究。

title: Simple QKD keyrate computations from tangent-line bounds
abstract: Recent work in quantum key distribution (QKD) has yielded finite-size keyrates based on convex optimisation problems, using the framework of entropy accumulation. Multiple solvers have been developed to address these optimisations in recent years, but have been based on a somewhat elaborate framework using sophisticated algorithms, in order to accommodate a broad range of QKD protocols. In this work, we note that for basic QKD protocols such as qubit BB84, the keyrates can be easily computed using off-the-shelf solvers instead, by obtaining suitable tangent lines to lower bound terms in the objective function. We compute the resulting finite-size keyrates and compare them to previous work. Moreover, we extend this approach to the six-state protocol, by deriving closed-form expressions for the single-round Rényi entropies in the protocol. This should facilitate subsequent study of the six-state protocol via entropy accumulation.
summary: 最近在量子密钥分配（QKD）方面的工作已经使用熵累积的框架，基于凸优化问题产生了有限大小的密钥率。近年来，已经开发了多个求解器来解决这些优化问题，但都是基于使用复杂算法的复杂框架，以便适应广泛的 QKD 协议。在这项工作中，我们注意到，对于基本的 QKD 协议（例如 qubit BB84），可以使用现成的求解器轻松计算密钥率，方法是获得目标函数中下界项的合适切线。我们计算所得的有限大小密钥率并将其与之前的工作进行比较。此外，我们通过推导协议中单轮 Rényi 熵的封闭式表达式，将这种方法扩展到六状态协议。这应该有助于随后通过熵累积对六状态协议进行研究。

title: When Does a Quantum Speedup Survive End-to-End?
abstract: Primitive quantum speedups are interface-relative: they depend on the input access used to run the primitive and on the output contract used to consume its state or samples. This paper introduces a transcript-level admissibility relation \(A_M\preceq_{\mathrm{int}}A_Q\), defined relative to the declared implementation package of the quantum interface. It identifies which adaptive classical access transcripts that same package licenses, with all setup, transcript-generation, and precision overheads charged. The main application is an operational audit for normalized-Betti estimation in clique-complex TDA, separating three declared-interface regimes. Reversible indexed simplex interfaces certify matched classical simplex sampling and local Laplacian row access by evaluating their reversible routines on single computational branches. Membership-based preparations induce a rejection route of overhead \(\binom{n}{k+1}/|S_k|\). Abstract spectral or block-encoding interfaces require an accompanying implementation package, transcript reduction, or shared representation. Under the indexed certificate and interface closure, the end-to-end cost is fixed by the imported estimator's spectral dependence on the gap \(\gamma\); the concretely realized bounded-treewidth family already admits exact \(\mathrm{poly}(n)\) classical Betti computation by rank over \(\mathbb{Q}\). A low-rank separation supports the role of access and output contracts.
summary:
原语量子加速与接口相关：它们取决于用于运行原语的输入访问以及用于消耗其状态或样本的输出契约。本文介绍了一个转录本级别的可接纳性关系 \(A_M\preceq_{\mathrm{int}}A_Q\)，它是相对于量子接口声明的实现包定义的。它可以识别相同包许可的自适应经典访问转录本，并收取所有设置、转录本生成和精确开销。主要应用是对 clique-complex TDA 中标准化 Betti 估计的操作审计，分离三个声明的接口机制。可逆索引单纯形接口通过评估单个计算分支上的可逆例程来证明匹配的经典单纯形采样和局部拉普拉斯行访问。基于成员资格的准备会导致开销的拒绝路径\(\binom{n}{k+1}/|S_k|\)。抽象光谱或块编码接口需要附带的实现包、转录缩减或共享表示。

在索引证书和接口闭包下，端到端成本由导入的估计器对间隙 \(\gamma\) 的谱依赖性固定；具体实现的有界树宽度族已经允许通过在 \(\mathbb{Q}\) 上进行排序来进行精确的 \(\mathrm{poly}(n)\) 经典 Betti 计算。低等级分离支持访问和输出合约的作用。

title: From Block-encoding to Generalized Quantum Signal Processing: Principles, Algorithms and Applications
abstract: Modern quantum algorithms are increasingly formulated as coherent procedures for implementing polynomial transformations of operators and singular values. This perspective provides a powerful and unifying language for quantum algorithm design, connecting a wide range of distinct problems through five closely related key tools: block-encoding, qubitization, QSP, QSVT and GQSP. Block-encoding embeds non-unitary matrices into larger unitaries; qubitization converts block-encodings into structured operators; QSP, QSVT and GQSP enable polynomial transformations with near-optimal query complexity. Together, these techniques form a general toolkit for transforming matrix functions into implementable quantum circuits. This paper develops these techniques from first principles as a unified framework for constructing quantum algorithms. We apply this framework to representative applications to highlight design principles and demonstrate how distinct algorithms can be constructed from a unified sequence of operator transformations. A central contribution is a systematic decision workflow for selecting the appropriate approach according to the operator structure and the desired transformation polynomial. This perspective clarifies when direct GQSP or through qubitization, or Laurent expansion, or QSVT is most appropriate. We organize algorithmic design into an end-to-end pipeline: identifying the target matrix function, constructing an appropriate block-encoding, determining the relevant spectral domain, designing a polynomial or Laurent-polynomial approximation, synthesizing the phase factors, and translating the transformation into an executable quantum circuit. By applying this unified framework to example applications, we showcase a practical methodology for reasoning, designing, and implementing quantum algorithms based on polynomial transformations.
summary:
现代量子算法越来越多地被表述为用于实现算子和奇异值多项式变换的连贯程序。这种观点为量子算法设计提供了一种强大且统一的语言，通过五个密切相关的关键工具连接各种不同的问题：块编码、量子位化、QSP、QSVT 和 GQSP。块编码将非酉矩阵嵌入到更大的酉矩阵中；量子位化将块编码转换为结构化运算符； QSP、QSVT 和 GQSP 可实现具有接近最优查询复杂性的多项式转换。这些技术共同构成了一个通用工具包，用于将矩阵函数转换为可实现的量子电路。本文从基本原理出发开发这些技术，作为构建量子算法的统一框架。我们将此框架应用于代表性应用程序，以突出设计原则并演示如何从统一的运算符转换序列构建不同的算法。

一个核心贡献是系统化的决策工作流程，用于根据算子结构和所需的变换多项式选择适当的方法。这个观点阐明了直接 GQSP 或通过量子位化、洛朗展开或 QSVT 何时最合适。我们将算法设计组织成端到端的管道：识别目标矩阵函数，构建适当的块编码，确定相关的谱域，设计多项式或洛朗多项式近似，综合相位因子，并将变换转换为可执行的量子电路。通过将这个统一的框架应用于示例应用程序，我们展示了基于多项式变换的推理、设计和实现量子算法的实用方法。

title: Direct Cultivation of Entangled $|CS\rangle$ Magic States
abstract: Magic-state cultivation has so far focused mainly on single-qubit non-Clifford resources. We develop a direct cultivation architecture for the entangled state $|CS\rangle=CS|++\rangle$. Two commuting Clifford involutions project onto four usable branches related by Pauli-frame updates. A minimal six-bit $[6,2,4]$ record protects the branch label against readout errors that map one valid record to another. Verified CAT$_7$ gadgets, Steane error detection, CZZ-based controlled checks, and immediate Steane-to-surface expansion form the complete factory. The decoder uses 263 operational detector bits, while 168 additional bits are withheld for later validation. Decoding proceeds through exact low-order resolution, a precomputed higher-order catalogue, and four-coset BP+OSD. Under the stated active-location stochastic-Pauli model, exact enumeration finds no accepted closed-boundary logical-failure mechanism through fault order two, while explicit order-three failure mechanisms exist. Finite-$p$ simulations quantify acceptance, residual syndromes, and decoder workload, and targeted sampling of order-three faults estimates the leading logical-error channels. Optimizing the direct $d=5\rightarrow13$ expansion reduces accepted-output operation count by approximately 35--37\%. We compare the two routes at the same binary logical-error rate. Direct CS remains cheaper in operation count at the two lower-noise benchmark points even when the three-$T$ route is given pre-existing output patches. The ordering reverses between $8\times10^{-4}$ and $9\times10^{-4}$. These results show that an entangled non-Clifford state can be cultivated directly with a protected branch record and an explicitly certified fault-order-three output channel.
summary:
到目前为止，魔态培育主要集中在单量子位非克利福德资源上。我们为纠缠态 $|CS\rangle=CS|++\rangle$ 开发了一种直接培养架构。两个通勤克利福德对合投影到与泡利框架更新相关的四个可用分支上。最小六位 $[6,2,4]$ 记录可保护分支标签免受将一个有效记录映射到另一记录的读出错误。经过验证的 CAT$_7$ 小工具、Steane 错误检测、基于 CZZ 的控制检查以及整个工厂的即时 Steane 到表面扩展。解码器使用 263 个操作检测器位，同时保留 168 个附加位以供以后验证。解码通过精确的低阶分辨率、预先计算的高阶目录和四陪集 BP+OSD 进行。在所述主动位置随机泡利模型下，精确枚举没有发现通过二阶故障的公认闭边界逻辑故障机制，而存在显式三阶故障机制。有限$p$模拟量化了接受度、残余综合症和解码器工作负载，并且对三阶故障进行有针对性的采样来估计主要逻辑错误通道。

优化直接 $d=5\rightarrow13$ 扩展可将接受的输出操作数减少大约 35--37\%。我们以相同的二进制逻辑错误率比较两条路线。即使 3-$T$ 路线已给出预先存在的输出补丁，直接 CS 在两个较低噪声基准点的操作计数仍然更便宜。 $8\times10^{-4}$ 和 $9\times10^{-4}$ 之间的顺序相反。这些结果表明，可以使用受保护的分支记录和明确认证的故障三阶输出通道直接培养纠缠非 Clifford 状态。

title: One Relative Phase Orders Operational Thresholds of Noisy Bell Pairs
abstract: Unlike the two-qubit entangled and CHSH-nonlocal sets, the steerable and Bell-nonlocal ones have no known general closed-form criterion. For any such operational ability whose failing states form a convex set closed under local unitaries, and for a Bell mixture with arbitrary noise, the $X$ part of the noise gives an upper bound on the definitive threshold, the Bell weight above which the mixture attains the ability. That bound is the tightest that the seven of the fifteen Pauli expectation values fixing the $X$ part can support. The same theorem shows that a state has the ability whenever its $X$ part does, so partial tomography of a state can certify its ability. When noise is of $X$ form, the mixture carries a relative phase between the noise and Bell coherences that cannot be gauged away by local unitaries, and it controls the threshold through interference. We prove a monotonicity law: the threshold is nondecreasing in this phase, whether or not a closed-form criterion for the ability exists.
summary: 与两个量子位纠缠和 CHSH 非局部集合不同，可操纵和 Bell 非局部集合没有已知的通用封闭形式准则。对于任何这样的操作能力，其失效状态形成在局部酉下闭合的凸集，并且对于具有任意噪声的贝尔混合，噪声的$X$部分给出了确定阈值的上限，贝尔权重高于该混合获得能力。该界限是固定 $X$ 部分的 15 个泡利期望值中的 7 个可以支持的最严格界限。同样的定理表明，只要状态的 $X$ 部分有能力，状态就有能力，因此状态的部分断层扫描可以证明其能力。当噪声为$X$形式时，混合物在噪声和贝尔相干性之间具有相对相位，该相对相位无法通过局部酉测量出来，并且它通过干扰来控制阈值。我们证明了单调性定律：无论是否存在能力的封闭形式标准，阈值在此阶段都是不递减的。

title: Accelerating A*-Based Algorithms for Decoding Quantum Low-Density Parity-Check Codes
abstract: Quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes represent a promising approach for error correction in quantum computing. The recently proposed Tesseract decoder uses the A* search algorithm that guarantees finding the most likely error pattern. However, practical implementations of Tesseract often involve an extremely large graph, and the inherently sequential nature of the search results in high computational overhead and long runtime. To improve decoding efficiency, we propose a two-stage decoding framework. First, a belief propagation (BP) decoder efficiently processes the syndrome. This step generates hard decisions (a binary error vector) and soft information (per-qubit confidence levels). In non-convergent BP cases, a gating mechanism examines the BP decoder's output to identify and filter out qubits with oscillating confidence values. In these cases, the refined output serves as input to Tesseract, which then attempts to identify and correct any residual errors. This hybrid approach leverages the high speed of BP decoding and delegates the more challenging decoding instances to Tesseract. Numerical results demonstrate a substantial reduction in overall decoding complexity while maintaining the logical error rate (LER) of the stand-alone Tesseract. Across all tested physical error rates, the proposed method achieves at least 5x reduction in the number of expanded nodes in the Tesseract, with a peak reduction of nearly 15x at a physical error rate of p = 0.05 for the [[126, 12, d < 11]] T1 code, and approximately 8.8x at p = 0.05 for the [[72, 12, 6]] bicycle bivariate (BB) code.
summary:
量子低密度奇偶校验（QLDPC）码代表了量子计算中一种有前途的纠错方法。最近提出的 Tesseract 解码器使用 A* 搜索算法，保证找到最可能的错误模式。然而，Tesseract 的实际实现通常涉及非常大的图，并且搜索固有的顺序性质会导致高计算开销和长运行时间。为了提高解码效率，我们提出了两阶段解码框架。首先，置信传播（BP）解码器有效地处理综合症。此步骤生成硬决策（二进制误差向量）和软信息（每个量子位的置信水平）。在非收敛 BP 情况下，门控机制会检查 BP 解码器的输出，以识别和过滤掉具有振荡置信值的量子位。在这些情况下，精炼后的输出将作为 Tesseract 的输入，然后 Tesseract 会尝试识别并纠正任何残留错误。这种混合方法利用了 BP 解码的高速性，并将更具挑战性的解码实例委托给 Tesseract。

数值结果表明，整体解码复杂度显着降低，同时保持独立 Tesseract 的逻辑错误率 (LER)。在所有测试的物理错误率中，所提出的方法使 Tesseract 中扩展节点的数量减少了至少 5 倍，对于 [[126, 12, d < 11]] T1 代码，在 p = 0.05 的物理错误率下峰值减少了近 15 倍，对于 [[72, 12, 6]] 自行车双变量 (BB) 在 p = 0.05 时峰值减少了大约 8.8 倍代码。

title: Why three? A two-level system with four mutually unbiased questions
abstract: Two sharp yes/no questions are mutually unbiased if and only if their involutions anticommute. A set of unbiased questions is therefore a Clifford algebra, whose maximal size is odd, meaning four anticommuting questions typically imply a fifth: the two-level systems of real, complex and quaternionic quantum theory allow two, three and five questions, while four is skipped. Without this operator product restriction, a two-level system with four unbiased questions exists as the four-dimensional Bloch ball, the hyperbit. The single-system postulates that pick out the Jordan state spaces allow such a model, and only energy observability rules it out. We show what it lacks, and realise it inside two qubits: its Kirkwood-Dirac imaginary parts are hidden $\mathfrak{so}(4)$ generators, its composites allow entanglement but no interaction, and its 24-cell of states stays Spekkens preparation contextual down to depolarising strength $2/3$. In fermionic terms, the four questions are the Majorana operators of two modes while the fifth is parity: the four-question system is therefore the sector removed by parity superselection.
summary: 两个尖锐的是/否问题是相互无偏见的，当且仅当它们的对合是反通易的。因此，一组无偏问题是克利福德代数，其最大尺寸为奇数，这意味着四个反交换问题通常意味着第五个：实数、复数和四元数量子论的两级系统允许两个、三个和五个问题，而四个则被跳过。如果没有这种算子乘积限制，则具有四个无偏问题的两级系统将作为四维布洛赫球（hyperbit）而存在。单系统假设选择约旦状态空间允许这样的模型，并且只有能量可观测性才排除它。我们展示了它所缺少的东西，并在两个量子位内实现它：它的柯克伍德-狄拉克虚部隐藏着 $\mathfrak{so}(4)$ 生成器，它的复合材料允许纠缠但没有相互作用，并且它的 24 单元状态保持 Spekkens 准备上下文到去极化强度 $2/3$。用费米子术语来说，这四个问题是两种模式的马约拉纳算子，而第五个问题是奇偶校验：因此，四问题系统是奇偶超选择删除的扇区。

title: Quantum Barankin bounds beyond local unbiasedness: Analytic results for Gaussian states via a right-division framework
abstract: We propose a quantum version of the Barankin bound as an alternative to the quantum Cramér-Rao bound for quantum parameter estimation. The quantum Barankin bound provides a lower bound on the mean squared error of estimators satisfying arbitrarily chosen bias constraints at arbitrarily chosen parameter points. In particular, unbiasedness over the entire parameter space can be imposed, yielding precision limits for globally unbiased quantum parameter estimation. In contrast to the recently derived quantum Barankin bound, which is based on a symmetric division superoperator, our bound is based on a nonsymmetric right-division superoperator. This formulation enables us to find analytic expressions for the Barankin matrix for Gaussian states, which allows for an efficient calculation of the bound. We demonstrate the usefulness of our results by applying them to various examples that exhibit the threshold effect in the few-shot regime, which is invisible to the standard quantum Cramér-Rao bound approach.
summary: 我们提出了巴兰金界的量子版本作为量子参数估计的量子 Cramér-Rao 界的替代方案。量子巴兰金界提供了在任意选择的参数点满足任意选择的偏差约束的估计器均方误差的下界。特别是，可以在整个参数空间上施加无偏性，从而产生全局无偏量子参数估计的精度限制。与最近导出的基于对称除法超级算子的量子巴兰金界限相比，我们的界限基于非对称右除超级算子。这个公式使我们能够找到高斯态巴兰金矩阵的解析表达式，从而可以有效地计算边界。我们通过将结果应用于各种在少样本状态下表现出阈值效应的例子来证明我们的结果的有用性，这对于标准量子 Cramér-Rao 束缚方法来说是不可见的。

title: Finite-Particle Quantum Reduction of Thermodynamic Irreversibility
abstract: Thermodynamics is useful because it lets us predict and control complex systems from a few accessible quantities when microscopic reconstruction is impractical. We ask whether this operational reduction can be less costly in a finite quantum system than in a matched classical one. We compare a few-boson Bose--Hubbard chain with its number-conserving classical-field counterpart under the same driving and the same coarse spatial record. The quantum system relaxes more in the observed particle distribution, yet the retained mean energy resolves more of the microscopic structure hidden by that record, leaving less information unusable and smaller entropy generation. We then close the process into a heat-engine cycle whose controls use only the measured mean energy and spatial record, not full state tomography; at matched thermal resources, the smaller entropy generation gives more work and higher efficiency. The advantage fades as the particle number grows toward the classical-field regime.
summary: 热力学很有用，因为当微观重建不切实际时，它可以让我们通过一些可访问的量来预测和控制复杂的系统。我们想知道，在有限量子系统中，这种操作减少的成本是否比匹配的经典系统要低。我们在相同的驱动和相同的粗略空间记录下将几个玻色子-哈伯德链与其对应的数守恒经典场链进行比较。量子系统在观察到的粒子分布中更加松弛，但保留的平均能量解析了该记录隐藏的更多微观结构，从而留下更少的不可用信息和更小的熵生成。然后，我们将该过程封闭为热机循环，其控制仅使用测量的平均能量和空间记录，而不是全状态断层扫描；在匹配的热资源下，较小的熵产生可以提供更多的功和更高的效率。随着粒子数向经典场状态增长，这种优势逐渐消失。

title: Solving wave propagation problems via geometric quantum state preparation on dispersion manifolds
abstract: We present a quantum algorithm for solving partial differential equations through a linear-system formulation, focusing on wave propagation problems described by the discretized Helmholtz equation in frequency domain. Although quantum linear-system solvers offer exponential compression of the system degrees of freedom, their runtime complexity is generally governed by the condition number of the discretized operator. Exploiting the analytic structure of the differential operator can provide an alternative to explicit matrix inversion, as illustrated for the screened Poisson equation through an explicit quantum circuit. For the Helmholtz equation, however, the inverse operator becomes singular on the dispersion surface $k^2=\omega^2/c^2$, rendering direct Fourier-space state-preparation methods exponentially inefficient. We address this challenge by directly preparing quantum states supported on the resonant manifold and encoding source locations through Fourier phases. The resulting algorithm eliminates the exponentially large overhead associated with post-selection on the resonant manifold, yielding a success probability that depends linearly on the number of sources and is independent of the computational domain size. More generally, our approach applies to hyperbolic differential equations whose Fourier-space solutions possess singular support on dispersion manifolds, recasting their solution as a problem of geometric quantum state preparation.
summary:
我们提出了一种通过线性系统公式求解偏微分方程的量子算法，重点关注频域中离散亥姆霍兹方程描述的波传播问题。尽管量子线性系统求解器提供系统自由度的指数压缩，但它们的运行时复杂性通常由离散算子的条件数决定。利用微分算子的解析结构可以提供显式矩阵求逆的替代方案，如通过显式量子电路的筛选泊松方程所示。然而，对于亥姆霍兹方程，逆算子在色散表面 $k^2=\omega^2/c^2$ 上变成奇异的，使得直接傅里叶空间状态准备方法的效率呈指数级低下。我们通过直接准备谐振流形上支持的量子态并通过傅里叶相位编码源位置来应对这一挑战。

由此产生的算法消除了与谐振流形上的后选择相关的指数级大开销，产生线性依赖于源数量并且与计算域大小无关的成功概率。更一般地，我们的方法适用于双曲微分方程，其傅立叶空间解在色散流形上具有奇异支持，将其解重新转换为几何量子态准备问题。

title: Programmable photonic state fusion via heralded storage of asynchronously generated resources
abstract: Probabilistic photonic sources generate elementary states in different trials, whereas multiphoton protocols require them to interfere in common temporal modes. We propose a fusion protocol that overcomes this mismatch by successively loading independently heralded photonic states into active storage loops. Conditioning on vacuum in monitored dump modes selects events in which each newly generated state is transferred into the same circulating modes as the photons already stored, thereby removing its generation time label. Provided the two alternatives of each elementary state undergo the same loading transformation, the accumulated state is described by a product of programmable linear factors, allowing a target superposition to be constructed by polynomial factorization. Adjusting the storage loop coupling as the state grows substantially improves the loading efficiency, changing the faster-than-exponential penalty of fixed balanced couplers to exponential scaling. We apply the protocol to two-photon path--frequency states for photonic clock interferometry and estimate the detected rate including source waiting time and round-trip loss.
summary: 概率光子源在不同的试验中产生基本状态，而多光子协议要求它们干扰常见的时间模式。我们提出了一种融合协议，通过将独立预示的光子态连续加载到活动存储循环中来克服这种不匹配。在受监控的转储模式中对真空进行调节会选择将每个新生成的状态转移到与已存储的光子相同的循环模式的事件，从而消除其生成时间标签。假设每个基本状态的两个替代方案经历相同的加载变换，则累积状态由可编程线性因子的乘积描述，从而允许通过多项式因式分解构建目标叠加。随着状态的增长调整存储环路耦合可显着提高加载效率，将固定平衡耦合器的快于指数的惩罚改为指数缩放。我们将该协议应用于光子时钟干涉测量的双光子路径频率状态，并估计检测到的速率，包括源等待时间和往返损耗。

title: Faster Computation with the Generalized Laplacian Quantum Walk
abstract: Quantum walks are the quantum analogues of classical random walks or Markov chains. They are universal models of quantum computing, and they underpin a variety of quantum algorithms. We prove that a continuous-time quantum walk effected by a generalized Laplacian, which can arise in spin chains, can solve a computational problem more quickly than typical quantum walks governed by the standard Laplacian or adjacency matrix. This generalized Laplacian consists of the standard Laplacian plus a real-valued multiple of the degree matrix, and we prove that as the magnitude of the multiple of the degree matrix is increased, its corresponding quantum walk can search the complete bipartite graph with multiple marked vertices in time that approaches the optimal. This raises the potential for the generalized Laplacian quantum walk to be a useful method for developing additional faster quantum algorithms.
summary: 量子游走是经典随机游走或马尔可夫链的量子类似物。它们是量子计算的通用模型，并且支撑着各种量子算法。我们证明，由广义拉普拉斯算子影响的连续时间量子行走（可以在自旋链中出现）可以比由标准拉普拉斯或邻接矩阵控制的典型量子行走更快地解决计算问题。该广义拉普拉斯算子由标准拉普拉斯算子加上度矩阵的实值倍数组成，我们证明，随着度矩阵倍数的幅值增大，其对应的量子游走能够及时搜索到接近最优的具有多个标记顶点的完整二分图。这提高了广义拉普拉斯量子行走成为开发其他更快量子算法的有用方法的潜力。

title: Symmetry structure dependent diagnostic of the Quantum Mpemba Effect
abstract: Understanding symmetry restoration in isolated quantum many-body systems is an important problem in nonequilibrium many-body quantum physics. Recent studies have shown that the quantum Mpemba effect can be characterized through entanglement asymmetry, where states with stronger initial symmetry breaking restore symmetry faster. However, it remains unclear whether conventional energy-based measures, such as the trace distance, capture the same phenomenon. We investigate this question in closed spin-$1/2$ quantum systems with different symmetries by analyzing the dynamics of symmetry-breaking initial states. Combining numerical simulations with an analytical decomposition of the trace distance into symmetry-coherence and residual contributions, we identify the conditions under which trace distance tracks entanglement asymmetry and reproduces the Mpemba--like behavior observed in it. For charge symmetry, the residual contribution is negligible, making the trace distance effectively governed by symmetry-sector coherences. In contrast, for permutation symmetry, a significant residual contribution leads to qualitatively different relaxation dynamics. Our results establish when conventional energy-based diagnostics reliably capture symmetry-restoration dynamics and clarify the distinct physical information encoded by entanglement asymmetry and trace distance.
summary:
理解孤立量子多体系统中的对称性恢复是非平衡多体量子物理中的一个重要问题。最近的研究表明，量子姆彭巴效应可以通过纠缠不对称性来表征，其中初始对称性破缺较强的态恢复对称性更快。然而，目前尚不清楚传统的基于能量的测量方法（例如迹线距离）是否能够捕获相同的现象。我们通过分析对称破缺初始态的动力学，在具有不同对称性的封闭自旋 $1/2$ 量子系统中研究这个问题。将数值模拟与迹线距离分析分解为对称相干性和剩余贡献相结合，我们确定了迹线距离跟踪纠缠不对称性的条件，并重现了其中观察到的类似 Mpemba 的行为。对于电荷对称性，残余贡献可以忽略不计，使得迹线距离有效地由对称扇区相干性控制。相反，对于排列对称性，显着的残差贡献会导致性质不同的松弛动力学。

我们的结果表明，传统的基于能量的诊断何时能够可靠地捕获对称性恢复动力学，并阐明由纠缠不对称性和迹线距离编码的独特物理信息。

title: Faster Quantum Monte Carlo Simulation by Random Compilation
abstract: Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) algorithms are among the most powerful classical methods for simulating quantum systems, yet their accuracy is often limited by the systematic errors in the approximations used, such as Trotterization. Here we introduce randomly compiled quantum Monte Carlo (RC-QMC) as a general framework that suppresses these systematic errors by averaging over a family of approximations rather than relying on a single fixed one. This strategy is grounded in the concept of randomized compiling from quantum computing, which suppresses errors by sampling over quantum gates, at essentially no additional computational cost. Consequently, our framework achieves a computational advantage over standard QMC methods when estimating a target state to a desired level of accuracy. We illustrate this advantage on two key Monte Carlo algorithms: (1) path integral quantum Monte Carlo for estimating thermal states, and (2) the quantum trajectories method for simulating open system dynamics. In aggregate, these results represent a cross-fertilization of quantum and classical algorithms, are readily generalizable to other QMC methods, and suggest wider applications in classical simulation.
summary: 量子蒙特卡罗 (QMC) 算法是模拟量子系统的最强大的经典方法之一，但其准确性通常受到所使用的近似值（例如 Trotterization）中的系统误差的限制。在这里，我们引入随机编译的量子蒙特卡罗（RC-QMC）作为通用框架，通过对一系列近似值进行平均而不是依赖于单个固定近似值来抑制这些系统误差。该策略基于量子计算的随机编译概念，通过量子门采样来抑制错误，而基本上不需要额外的计算成本。因此，在将目标状态估计到所需的准确度时，我们的框架比标准 QMC 方法具有计算优势。我们通过两个关键的蒙特卡罗算法说明了这一优势：（1）用于估计热状态的路径积分量子蒙特卡罗，以及（2）用于模拟开放系统动力学的量子轨迹方法。总的来说，这些结果代表了量子和经典算法的交叉融合，很容易推广到其他 QMC 方法，并在经典模拟中提出了更广泛的应用。

title: Noether Symmetries Generate Deterministic Energy-Harvesting Protocols
abstract: We consider the general principles for when deterministic energy harvesting (DEH) is possible. DEH means absorbing energy from a fluctuating source without entropy being absorbed. We show that the symmetry structure of the source--harvester dynamics gives a general route beyond existing examples to identify DEH capable source states. Any continuous symmetry with a conserved Noether charge induces a source-side orbit of states that all implement the same deterministic harvester transition, provided the harvester boundary states are symmetry invariant. Consequently, one DEH capable source state with nonzero asymmetry between charge sectors can generate infinitely many simultaneously DEH capable source states. A Jaynes-Cummings model, a three-spin XX chain, and an SU(2) model illustrate the construction. We further extend Noether's theorem to generalised probabilistic theories and thereby generalise our main result. We further establish an asymmetry bound for harvesting, showing that source asymmetry cannot increase on average, while DEH saturates the bound exactly preserving asymmetry.
summary: 我们考虑何时可以实现确定性能量收集 (DEH) 的一般原则。 DEH 意味着从波动源吸收能量而不吸收熵。我们表明，源-收集器动力学的对称结构提供了超越现有示例的一般途径，以识别具有 DEH 能力的源态。任何具有守恒诺特电荷的连续对称性都会引起源侧状态轨道，所有这些状态都实现相同的确定性收集器跃迁，前提是收集器边界态是对称不变的。因此，电荷扇区之间具有非零不对称性的一种具有 DEH 能力的源态可以同时生成无限多个具有 DEH 能力的源态。 Jaynes-Cummings 模型、三自旋 XX 链和 SU(2) 模型说明了该结构。我们进一步将诺特定理推广到广义概率理论，从而推广我们的主要结果。我们进一步建立了收获的不对称界限，表明源不对称性平均不能增加，而 DEH 使界限饱和，完全保留了不对称性。
